remarks: Spacious updated first floor 1-bedroom apartment located within walking distance to the beach! Features include a large living area, updated kitchen (w separate nook) and bath, generous closet space, assigned parking, and onsite laundry in the building. Additional offering of a large storage area in the basement (save on monthly storage costs). Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, and public transportation. Enjoy comfortable coastal living in a well-maintained complex with lovely landlords. Don't miss this one! No smoking and no dogs, cats are welcome! Must have good credit (675 or higher) and proof of income. Applications pulled via RentSpree. Clean and move in ready, available for immediate occupancy.
